# Research register: 543 catalog entries

This is a documented first pass, not an exhaustive search of all libraries. Each entry has an Internet Archive metadata search. Specific results are **unreviewed candidates** unless an edition is separately selected below. Some hits are studies, wrong authors, wrong languages, or wrong variants. No hit means no result from these queries, not that the work is unavailable. Downloaded OCR has not been collated against manuscripts.

The original catalog remains unchanged. Catalog edition leads are reproduced as provisional research, not newly verified claims.

## ACU-0006

**Annales Cambriae B and C texts** — Latin; anon..

Status: Original-language source downloaded; coverage notes apply.

Catalog edition lead (provisional): Henry Gough-Cooper, Welsh Chronicles Research Group online editions.

- Selected edition: [Annales Cambriae: the B text](https://archive.org/details/ac-b-first-edition). Gough-Cooper 2015 Latin B-text transcription of National Archives E164/1, pp. 2–26.
